build.beforeDevCommand: npm run build:backend --prefix .. && npm run dev -w client
build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run build -w shared --prefix .. && npm run build -w server --prefix .. && npm run build -w client --prefix ..

security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:* ws://127.0.0.1:*; img-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'
